handoff_order: Orders from the owner: your context has passed the size limit ({cap} tokens per call). Finish the step you are on at a point where nothing is half done (not the whole task), save and commit what you have, then write your hand-over note exactly as {run}/_handoff-rule.md says (handoff-<role>.md, line 1 `HANDOFF <role> after Task <N> — <date time>`) and end your turn. Start no waiter and no new work; a fresh session continues from your note and the files. The note carries the facts the next session needs, copied in, not pointers to them.
unblock: Your last command waited more than 10 minutes for a permission approval that nobody could give, so the owner's watcher cancelled it and restarted you. Do not run that command again. Reach the same result another way that needs no approval (reading with sed -n or python3; writing your own files with Write, Edit, or a python3 script written with Write and run by path); if there is none, record the step as open in your log and go on with your work. Work in English only.

The note carries the state: open the record files only when your first step needs them, by line ranges, never whole. Do the unit (Task 1-5) the note names.
